description: This file defines the TalkOverlayController class, which manages the presentation and behavior of a talk overlay UI component in a macOS app. It includes methods for showing, hiding, and updating the overlay's visual state and phase, as well as handling window setup and positioning.

classes.name: TalkOverlayController
classes.description: A singleton class managing the lifecycle, display, and state of the talk overlay in a macOS application.

classes.name: TalkOverlayHostingView
classes.description: A subclass of NSHostingView used to host TalkOverlayView with custom mouse event handling.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Displays the overlay window with the current view.

methods.name: updatePhase
methods.description: Updates the overlay's current phase and logs the change.

methods.name: updatePaused
methods.description: Updates the paused state of the overlay and logs the change.

methods.name: updateLevel
methods.description: Adjusts the overlay's level indicator within the display bounds.

methods.name: currentWindowOrigin
methods.description: Returns the current window origin coordinates.

methods.name: setWindowOrigin
methods.description: Sets the window's origin to a specified CGPoint.

methods.name: ensureWindow
methods.description: Initializes the overlay window if it doesn't already exist.

methods.name: targetFrame
methods.description: Computes and returns the frame rectangle for positioning the overlay window.
